request.initial_prompt: Mitya had been, all this time, holding in his hand the crumpled bundle of notes on which the eyes of all, especially of the Poles, were fixed. In confusion he thrust them hurriedly into his pocket. He flushed. At that moment the innkeeper brought in an uncorked bottle of champagne, and glasses on a tray. Mitya snatched up the bottle, but he was so bewildered that he did not know what to do with it. Kalganov took it from him and poured out the champagne.

raw_segments.text: Mitya had been, all this time, holding in his hand the crumpled bundle of notes on which the eyes of all, especially of the Poles, were fixed.
In confusion he thrust them hurriedly into his pocket. He flushed.
At that moment the innkeeper brought in an uncorked bottle of champagne, and glasses on a tray.
Mitya snatched up the bottle, but he was so bewildered that he did not know what to do with it.
Kalganov took it from him and poured out the champagne.
